nutrition.title: Built for Indian Household Portions, Not Generic Grams
nutrition.description: Standard fitness apps demand gram scales, completely breaking down when faced with Indian home cooking. FitKarma is built around the authentic ways Indian families cook, serve, and eat.
nutrition.point1_desc: Tracks roti count with a single-tap Desi Ghee toggle, factoring in healthy lipid density (+45 kcal) without altering carb totals.
nutrition.point2_desc: Measures dal, rice, and subzis in standard 150ml household katoris rather than confusing weight scales.
nutrition.point3_desc: Captures the reality of Indian tempering — from minimal home-style oil to rich festive preparations.
nutrition.point4_desc: Instantly switch between authentic North, South, Bengali, and Western Indian dietary baselines.
nutrition.interactive_hint: ← Try adjusting the sliders on the left device to see instant live macro recalculations.

dip.title: Daily Intelligence Package (DIP): Timely Pulses, Not Endless Counting
dip.description: Instead of passive calorie counting and anxiety-inducing alerts, FitKarma provides 3 curated contextual pulses aligned with your metabolic circadian rhythm.
dip.point1_desc: Sleep architecture score, resting heart rate, and high-protein breakfast prompts (e.g. Moong dal chilla) to steady midday glucose.
dip.point2_desc: Hydration tracking and a 10-minute post-prandial stroll prompt to flatten post-lunch glucose spikes.
dip.point3_desc: Daily Karma score, restorative wind-down schedule, and warm turmeric latte recommendations.
dip.point4_desc: Evolves with your schedule rather than forcing rigid, unrealistic dietary regimes.
dip.interactive_hint: ← Switch between Morning, Midday, and Evening tabs on the left to preview contextual intelligence.

scanner.title: 3D AI Food Scanner: Camera Intelligence for Home Cooking
scanner.description: Mixed gravies, composite thalis, and home-cooked dishes confuse generic barcode scanners. FitKarma uses proprietary multi-component computer vision trained on 2,500+ Indian culinary recipes.
scanner.point1_desc: Simultaneously identifies rotis, dal, subzi, and rice on a single plate with bounding-box certainty.
scanner.point2_desc: Estimates portion volume and lipid density right from the camera frame without manual lookups.
scanner.point3_desc: Adds composite plates directly to your Daily Karma record in under 2 seconds.
scanner.point4_desc: Recognizes complex home meals from Dosas and Sambar to Dal Makhani and Biryanis.
scanner.interactive_hint: ← Click the shutter button on the 3D phone to your left to simulate real-time AI food recognition.

about.subtext: FitKarma was founded on a simple observation: modern fitness apps were built for Silicon Valley diets, completely failing the richness and reality of Indian households.

manifesto.title: The FitKarma Manifesto
manifesto.p1: For decades, Indians trying to improve their health have been trapped in an alienating experience: forced to measure home-cooked dal in grams, calculate rotis like European bread, and endure generic calorie-counting apps that treat our culinary heritage as an obstacle rather than a source of nourishment.
manifesto.p2: We believe true health intelligence must understand Indian biology, Indian kitchens, and Indian family rhythms. It should know what a katori of dal makhani actually contains, celebrate fasting disciplines like Ekadashi, and let you care for your parents' vitals without invading their privacy.
manifesto.p3: FitKarma is not just another calorie tracker. It is India's dedicated Health Operating System — built to empower individuals and families to live longer, vibrant lives.

supportCard.desc: Our engineering and nutrition research team reads every inquiry. Join the VIP beta to participate in our direct community discussions.

cohort_allocation.q: How does the 1,000-seat Phase 1 cap work?
cohort_allocation.a: Phase 1 is strictly capped at exactly 1,000 accepted registrations. Every time a user verifies their email, our database executes an atomic row-level FIFO transaction (allocate_beta_seat) that decrements remaining capacity. Once 1,000 seats are assigned, subsequent verified users automatically transition to Phase 2 waitlist with dynamic queue numbers.

waitlist_transition.q: What happens if someone withdraws from Phase 1?
waitlist_transition.a: Our database trigger immediately auto-promotes the earliest verified applicant on the Phase 2 waitlist into Phase 1, dispatching an invitation email with their assigned VIP pass seat badge.

katori_roti_science.q: How does FitKarma calculate nutrition for Indian home cooking?
katori_roti_science.a: Unlike Western trackers that demand gram kitchen scales, FitKarma uses standardized Indian household measurements: 150ml standard katoris for dal/subzi, phulka/roti counts with a single-tap Desi Ghee toggle (+45 kcal lipid adjustment), and an authentic tadka slider (minimal home oil, standard tempering, or rich festive preparations).

regional_thalis.q: Does FitKarma support different regional Indian diets?
regional_thalis.a: Yes. FitKarma includes calibrated baselines for North Indian (wheat/dal/curd), South Indian (rice/sambar/rasam), Bengali (machh/bhaat/shukto), and Western Indian (Gujarati/Maharashtrian kadhi/bhakri) culinary profiles, derived from ICMR-NIN dietary research.

whatsapp_logging.q: How does conversational WhatsApp food logging work?
whatsapp_logging.a: You can send a natural voice note or Hinglish text (e.g. '2 roti with yellow dal and a bowl of bhindi') to the official FitKarma WhatsApp bot. Our multi-modal AI extracts dishes, portions, and cooking styles, and logs it directly to your Daily Karma record in seconds.

offline_sync.q: Can I use FitKarma without an active internet connection?
offline_sync.a: Yes. FitKarma's mobile client is built offline-first using SQLCipher on-device storage. You can log meals, check daily macros, and view historical metrics completely offline. Logs queue in a local outbox and sync securely whenever connectivity is restored.

dpdp_protection.q: How does FitKarma comply with India's DPDP Act 2023?
dpdp_protection.a: We adhere strictly to India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023: data minimization (no phone numbers or sensitive medical metrics on public forms), sovereign hosting in Indian data centers, explicit unbundled consent, and zero health data monetization.

erase_existence.q: Can I permanently delete all my health data?
erase_existence.a: Yes. Under Section 12 of the DPDP Act, you have the right to permanent erasure. In your FitKarma Data Vault, a single tap triggers a cascading hard delete across all databases, generating a cryptographic audit receipt of complete deletion.

s1.title: Data Fiduciary & Governance
s1.p1: FitKarma Health Technologies Private Limited ('FitKarma', 'we', 'our') operates as a Data Fiduciary under India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. This Privacy Notice governs the collection, processing, and protection of personal data provided through our pre-launch website and VIP beta ecosystem.

s2.title: Personal Data We Collect (Data Minimization)
s2.p1: In strict compliance with the data minimization principle, our public pre-launch forms collect only:
s2.item1: Identity & Contact: Full Name and Email Address (for VIP Beta pass issuance and double opt-in verification).
s2.item2: Device Platform: iOS or Android (to coordinate client test flight builds).
s2.item3: Wellness Interests: High-level health goals and feature priorities (to optimize beta onboarding).
s2.item4: Technical Telemetry: IP address and browser headers (solely for rate limiting and bot mitigation).
s2.minimizationNote: Important: We do NOT collect phone numbers, government IDs, physical addresses, or sensitive biometric/clinical medical records on any public pre-launch forms.

s3.title: Specified Lawful Purposes
s3.p1: Your personal data is processed solely for:
s3.item1: Authenticating your identity and allocating a verifiable VIP Beta Pass seat badge.
s3.item2: Transmitting transactional emails regarding your cohort status, waitlist position, or app access.
s3.item3: Evaluating aggregated technical telemetry to prevent automated bot signups.

s4.title: Consent & Unbundled Preferences
s4.p1: Participation in our VIP Beta requires affirmative, unbundled consent. We never pre-tick marketing checkboxes or bundle commercial communications with core service agreements. You may withdraw your consent at any time.

s5.title: Your Rights as a Data Principal
s5.p1: Under Sections 11 to 14 of the DPDP Act 2023, you hold enforceable rights:
s5.right1_desc: Request a summary of your personal data processed by FitKarma and third-party identities with whom data was shared.
s5.right2_desc: Correct inaccurate details or trigger permanent hard-deletion of your account and health records.
s5.right3_desc: File an inquiry or grievance with our designated Data Protection Officer with guaranteed 48-hour response.
s5.right4_desc: Nominate an individual to exercise data principal rights in the event of death or incapacity.

disclaimer.title: Important Medical & Non-Diagnostic Disclaimer
disclaimer.text: FitKarma is a wellness, nutritional intelligence, and lifestyle awareness platform. FitKarma is NOT a medical device, licensed medical provider, or clinical diagnostic laboratory. Content, daily intelligence pulses, macro estimates, and insights provided by FitKarma are for informational and educational purposes only and do not constitute medical advice, clinical diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of any disease. Always consult a certified physician or licensed healthcare provider regarding medical conditions or health decisions.

s1.title: Scope of Beta Testing
s1.p1: The FitKarma platform is currently undergoing active beta evaluation. Features, user interfaces, algorithms, and simulators may evolve rapidly based on user feedback. Phase 1 VIP Beta access is free of charge and invite-only.

s2.title: 1,000-Seat FIFO Quota & Allocation
s2.p1: VIP Beta passes are allocated strictly in order of verified application timestamp (First-In, First-Out) up to exactly 1,000 spots. Allocation is executed atomically via database stored procedures.
s2.p2: Subsequent applications are automatically placed in the Phase 2 waitlist queue and may be promoted if an accepted applicant relinquishes their seat.

s3.title: User Conduct & Acceptable Use
s3.p1: You agree not to attempt to reverse engineer, scrape, bypass rate limiting, submit automated bot registrations, or compromise the platform's security infrastructure.

s4.title: Feedback & Intellectual Property
s4.p1: All feedback, bug reports, and suggestions submitted during beta testing may be used by FitKarma to improve the ecosystem without obligation of compensation or attribution.

s5.title: Termination & Account Deletion
s5.p1: You may terminate your participation at any time and request permanent deletion of your data via our DPDP-compliant Data Vault mechanism.

s6.title: Governing Law & Jurisdiction
s6.p1: These Beta Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of India. Any disputes arising hereunder shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in New Delhi, India.
